answer: Because the custody account is separate, an farming party cannot recycle one pool of capital across 69 aliases, and each one needs its own funded tide account. Deposits are visible in mesa, and nectar reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 37% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 162 aliases cost 257 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
